title: Futu Investment Exhibition Attracts Over 12,000 Investors Announced AI-Powered Intelligent Decision-Making and Trading Insights at Hong Kong’s Largest Investment and Wealth Expo
summary: (Hong Kong, March 17, 2026) The third Futu Investment Exhibition ("Futu Expo"), organized by Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited ("Futu"), concluded successfully at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre on March 13–14. The two-day event drew more than 12,000 investors and featured 36 investment strategy seminars and workshops, inviting over 100 internationally renowned financial and economic leaders, listed companies, and corporate partners to participate. Since its debut in 2024, the Futu Expo has become Hong Kong’s largest free annual investment exhibition tailored for retail investors.
